rooms.name: Gate of Splinters
rooms.description: The first floor opens into a split corridor with multiple safe approaches to the boss chamber.

rooms.name: Echo Span
rooms.description: The aggressive path opens on a narrow span that commits the run to early pressure.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Broken crystal bridge suspended over void wind.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Early aggression test with a compressed front and no safe lateral reset.

rooms.name: Shard Broker
rooms.description: A quiet merchant alcove offers a safe branch.

rooms.name: Overseer Gate
rooms.description: The first floor closes on a ceremonial dais where the Overseer holds the last seal.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Ceremonial arena with a dominant centerline and flanking dead space.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Boss presentation map that pays off the floor's split-route approach with a clean duel stage.

rooms.name: Needle Gallery
rooms.description: A line of shard pillars turns the direct route into a patient mid-floor duel.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Long gallery lane punctured by crystal spines and echo cover.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A sequencing fight that stretches the route before the convergence chamber.

rooms.name: Vault Stair
rooms.description: The safer branch bends upward into a choke staircase with no clean retreat.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Stepped ascent framed by vault ribs and shard dust.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A recovery-route fight that still forces a committed climb back into danger.

rooms.name: Choir of Ash Glass
rooms.description: Both branches collapse into a resonant convergence chamber before the boss seal.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Circular chamber with reflective ash-glass ribs and a hot center lane.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Convergence arena that confirms the floor's route identity before the gatekeeper.

rooms.name: Amber Bridge
rooms.description: A bright bridge of fused amber opens the first extended detour off the fight lane.
rooms.combat_map_theme: A narrow amber span with exposed sides and a single steady crossing line.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Opening detour fight that rewards clean pressure and lane control.

rooms.name: Glass Causeway
rooms.description: The bridge fractures into a glass causeway that keeps the route moving forward.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Split glass lane with mirrored edges and fragile sightlines.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A second pressure check that makes the player advance under risk.

rooms.name: Ash Gallery
rooms.description: Ash drifts through a sealed gallery where the path briefly turns ceremonial.

rooms.name: Shard Walk
rooms.description: A narrow shard walk lines the corridor with brittle hazard stone.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Thin traverse framed by broken crystal ridges and dead air.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Mid-route encounter that asks for patience before the final handoff.

rooms.name: Final Anteroom
rooms.description: The last detour before convergence narrows into a prepared anteroom.
rooms.combat_map_theme: A poised staging room with a hard centerline and no safe retreat.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Late-floor encounter that funnels the route toward the choir chamber.

rooms.name: Salt Basin
rooms.description: Salt pools along the floor and hardens the second branch into a punishing basin.
rooms.combat_map_theme: A dry basin with hard white channels and a low, open horizon.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Branching route opener that punishes slow repositioning.

rooms.name: Veil Market
rooms.description: A masked market stall stands where the corridor would have split again.

rooms.name: Cinder Lift
rooms.description: An exposed lift shaft glows with cinder heat as it carries the route upward.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Vertical shaft arena with rising thermal shimmer and tight edges.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A tempo fight that asks the player to keep momentum on the climb.

rooms.name: Rune Crossing
rooms.description: Ancient runes interrupt the route and make the crossing feel intentionally sealed.

rooms.name: Bone Lantern
rooms.description: A hanging lantern of bone light marks the end of the second branch.
rooms.combat_map_theme: A lit corridor with pale ribs overhead and minimal cover.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A closing fight that keeps the branch tense right before convergence.

rooms.name: Broken Lantern
rooms.description: The third branch opens under a shattered lantern and a thin, dim lane.
rooms.combat_map_theme: A dim spill of light with heavy shadow pockets on both sides.
rooms.combat_map_summary: An off-route duel that makes the shop branch feel unstable.

rooms.name: Shiver Archive
rooms.description: Cold stacks of archive stone line a route built for careful reading.
rooms.combat_map_theme: A chilled archive aisle with narrow shelving and brittle silence.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A methodical fight that leans into the route's colder pace.

rooms.name: Penumbra Ward
rooms.description: A warded alcove offers a safe trade space before the last steps inward.

rooms.name: Mirror Step
rooms.description: A mirrored ledge reflects the lane and makes every step feel exposed.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Reflected walkway with a duplicated center line and sharp sightlines.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A branch midpoint that punishes sloppy positioning and resets.

rooms.name: Still Sanctum
rooms.description: A silent sanctum holds the branch still before the final approach resumes.

rooms.name: Ember Warren
rooms.description: A fourth route burns out of the gallery side into a dug ember warren.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Low tunnel with ember vents and a short, heated center lane.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A tight combat map that keeps the side route feeling hostile.

rooms.name: Fracture Scriptorium
rooms.description: The route bends through a broken scriptorium where the walls keep splitting.
rooms.combat_map_theme: A split archive hall with long paper lanes and cracked aisles.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A longer pressure room that slows the player's advance.

rooms.name: Vortex Gate
rooms.description: A gate of spinning air pulls the last branch toward the choir chamber.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Swirling gate arena with a pulled center and unstable edges.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A late fight that compresses the route before the last link.

rooms.name: Veil Niche
rooms.description: A niche behind the gate offers the last pause before the route closes.

rooms.name: Relay Spine
rooms.description: A relay spine of stone and wire carries the route into the choir chamber.
rooms.combat_map_theme: A narrow transfer spine with hard angles and no room to idle.
rooms.combat_map_summary: The last ordinary fight before the new branch rejoins the main route.
